name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-confirm-change-impact
title: Confirm Change Impact
shortDescription: Asks a person to confirm an assessed change order's impact, then applies the new dates and cost to the schedule and builds the contract addendum: cover sheet, signed contract, change order, merged into one PDF.
longDescription: Shows the schedule changes phase by phase with the completion and total before and after, and waits for the exact phrase "Confirm Change Impact". Anything else changes nothing.
Builds the addendum first (a filled cover sheet converted to PDF, merged with the unchanged signed contract and the change order) so a failure there leaves the schedule untouched.
Then copies each Change row's new values onto its Current row exactly once, updates the project totals, marks the Change rows Applied, and sets the change order to Reviewed.
